kebab_example: aliyun agentidentity list-role-assignments --user-pool-name my-agent-userpool --principal-name alice --principal-type User --role-name Analyst --max-results 100 --next-token TGlzdEFzc2lnbm1lbnRzOjoxMA== --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRoleAssignments

parameters.help_en: Filters results by principal name. If PrincipalType is set to User, specify the username. This parameter must be specified together with PrincipalType
parameters.help_zh: 按身份名称过滤。当 PrincipalType 为 User 时，传入用户名。必须与 PrincipalType 同时配置
parameters.name: principal_name

parameters.help_en: Filters results by principal type. Only User is supported. This parameter must be specified together with PrincipalName
parameters.help_zh: 按身份类型过滤。当前仅支持 User，需与 PrincipalName 同时配置
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的最大条目数。取值范围：1~1000，默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call. If a NextToken is returned in the response of a previous call, specify it in this call to retrieve the next page
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页数据的令牌。首次调用无需传入；当上一次调用返回结果中存在 NextToken 时，将其作为本次调用的入参以获取下一页
parameters.name: next_token

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the role assignment in ISO 8601 format (UTC)
CreateTime.description_zh: 角色分配的创建时间。ISO 8601 格式（UTC）

PrincipalId.description_en: The principal ID. If PrincipalType is User, this is the user ID
PrincipalId.description_zh: 身份 ID。当 PrincipalType 为 User 时，为用户 ID

PrincipalName.description_en: The principal name. If PrincipalType is User, this is the username
PrincipalName.description_zh: 身份名称。当 PrincipalType 为 User 时，为用户名

PrincipalType.description_en: The principal type. Currently, only User is supported
PrincipalType.description_zh: 身份类型。当前仅支持 User

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned in the current request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求返回的最大条目数

NextToken.description_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. An empty value indicates that no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh: 查询下一页数据的令牌。返回为空时表示已无更多数据

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of role assignments that match the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合条件的角色分配关系总数
